title: Writing a Story
ringkas: Alur, tokoh, latar, dan kata penghubung waktu
goals: menulis **cerita pendek** dengan awal, masalah, dan akhir
memakai **past simple dan past continuous** dalam cerita

lesson.text: Cerita yang baik punya tiga bagian: **awal** (tokoh dan tempat), **masalah** (apa yang terjadi), dan **akhir** (bagaimana selesai). Gunakan kalimat lampau dan penanda waktu agar alurnya jelas.

lesson.title: 1. Struktur cerita
table: [[One sunny morning, a boy named Budi walked to school.]]
[[Suddenly, he saw a small kitten stuck in a tree.]]
[[Budi climbed carefully and saved the kitten.]]
[[He felt proud, and he arrived at school smiling.]]

lesson.title: 2. Penanda waktu dan tense
table: [[While I was walking, it began to rain.]]
[[In the end, they found the way home.]]

lesson.title: Mulai dengan kejadian
lesson.text: Pembuka seperti *Suddenly, ...* atau *One night, ...* menarik pembaca lebih cepat daripada *This is a story about ...*.

items: Awal, masalah, penyelesaian, penutup.
Past simple untuk peristiwa, past continuous untuk latar.
Penanda: one day, suddenly, then, finally.
Dialog: tanda kutip dan said.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi cerita yang runtut.
items: One sunny morning, Budi walked to school.
Suddenly, he saw a small kitten stuck in a tree.
He put his bag down and climbed carefully.
Finally, he saved the kitten and carried it home.
He felt proud and arrived at school smiling.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi cerita yang runtut.
items: Last Saturday, Dina went to the market with her mother.
While they were shopping, it began to rain heavily.
They ran into a small cafe and ordered hot tea.
After an hour, the rain stopped.
They walked home under a bright rainbow.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi cerita yang runtut.
items: Tom was reading in his room one evening.
Suddenly, all the lights went out.
He found a torch and went to the kitchen.
There he saw that his sister had unplugged the fridge.
They both laughed and plugged it back in.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi cerita yang runtut.
items: Rani lost her notebook on the bus.
She felt worried because it had all her notes.
She went to the bus office the next morning.
A kind driver had kept the notebook for her.
Rani thanked him and promised to be more careful.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi cerita yang runtut.
items: It was the first day of school.
Ali felt nervous and could not find his classroom.
A friendly girl showed him the way.
They sat together and became good friends.
Ali learned that new places are not so scary.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi cerita yang runtut.
items: One night, a strange noise woke me up.
I held my breath and walked slowly to the kitchen.
A cat was sitting on the table, eating my fish.
I laughed and let it finish its meal.
Then I went back to bed.

practice.q: Pilih pembuka cerita yang paling menarik:
options: Suddenly, the door opened by itself.
This is a story about a door.
I will tell you something now.
There is a door in my house.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat penyelesaian yang baik:
options: In the end, they found the way home.

practice.q: Pilih tense yang tepat: "While I ___ home, it began to rain."
Pilih tense yang tepat: "Suddenly, the lights ___ out."
practice.exp: Past simple. Kalimat lengkap: **Suddenly, the lights went out.**

practice.q: Pilih kalimat dialog yang benar:
Pilih penanda waktu yang tepat untuk peristiwa tiba-tiba:
Pilih penanda waktu yang tepat untuk akhir cerita:
practice.exp: In the end. Jawaban yang tepat: **In the end**.

practice.q: Bagian "complication" berisi...
practice.exp: Masalah. Jawaban yang tepat: **masalah atau peristiwa yang mengganggu**.

practice.q: Bagian "orientation" berisi...
practice.exp: Orientasi. Jawaban yang tepat: **tokoh, tempat, dan waktu**.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang SALAH:
options: Yesterday I go to the market.
Yesterday I went to the market.
Last week she visited her aunt.
